text: The planet spins very fast: day and night yield different worlds
description: A sphere planet whose day/night phase switches the world's character (palette, structures, behaviour). Sun phase as a global conditioning input.

status.comment: First version: `day` fader (seconds per planet day), day phase in u.step.z, scene.frag circles the sun and blends to a night world (complementary dim colours, warm lit windows, cool moon). Seen 2026-11-24 (Monado simulated headset, nice-net, day 20, color 0.03, EYE_SIZE 256, snapshot near midnight): the city goes dim with hue-shifted blue/violet blocks and a cool bright ground, so night reads as a different palette; the lit windows are NOT visible at this resolution/uptake (windows ~0.8 m, blended in at 3% per frame and smoothed by the net). Human step: in the headset at 512 px, day ~60, color ~0.03: does night feel like another world? If windows should show, I can make them larger (fewer, brighter) or blend night features in faster.
